name: Apply and deploy Notes UX batch

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [gh-pages]
    paths:
      - '.github/workflows/bootstrap-notes-hotfix.yml'

permissions:
  contents: write

concurrency:
  group: notes-ux-batch
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  fix-build-deploy:
    if: github.event.pull_request.head.ref == 'hotfix/run-notes-production-build'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 35
    steps:
      - name: Checkout main
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: main
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Snapshot current Pages companion content
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: gh-pages
          path: pages
          fetch-depth: 1

      - name: Apply focused Notes UX fixes
        shell: bash
        run: |
          python3 - <<'PY'
          from pathlib import Path
          import re

          def load(path):
              return Path(path).read_text()

          def save(path, text):
              Path(path).write_text(text)

          def rep(path, old, new, count=1):
              text = load(path)
              hits = text.count(old)
              if hits < count:
                  raise SystemExit(f'{path}: expected >= {count} matches, found {hits}: {old[:90]!r}')
              text = text.replace(old, new, count)
              save(path, text)

          # 1) Notes grid: mobile-like card footprint, more columns on desktop,
          # and stable ordering while checkbox mode is active.
          path = 'lib/features/notes/widgets/notes_library_body.dart'
          rep(path,
              "  List<PlanningTask> _sortedTasks() {\n    final out = List<PlanningTask>.from(widget.tasks);\n",
              "  List<PlanningTask> _sortedTasks() {\n    final out = List<PlanningTask>.from(widget.tasks);\n    if (widget.checkboxesOn) return out;\n")
          rep(path,
              "    if (view == NotesLibraryView.grid) {\n      final crossAxisCount = availableWidth >= 720 ? 2 : 1;\n      return GridView.builder(\n        padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 4, bottom: 24),\n        gridDelegate: SliverGridDelegateWithFixedCrossAxisCount(\n          crossAxisCount: crossAxisCount,\n          mainAxisSpacing: 10,\n          crossAxisSpacing: 10,\n          childAspectRatio: crossAxisCount == 2 ? 1.22 : 1.35,\n        ),",
              "    if (view == NotesLibraryView.grid) {\n      return GridView.builder(\n        padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 4, bottom: 24),\n        gridDelegate: const SliverGridDelegateWithMaxCrossAxisExtent(\n          maxCrossAxisExtent: 290,\n          mainAxisSpacing: 10,\n          crossAxisSpacing: 10,\n          childAspectRatio: 1.0,\n        ),")

          # 2) Grid card typography + checkbox hit target.
          path = 'lib/features/notes/widgets/note_card.dart'
          text = load(path)
          grid_start = text.index('class _GridCard extends StatelessWidget')
          grid_end = text.index('// ---- List row', grid_start)
          grid = text[grid_start:grid_end]
          grid = grid.replace('fontSize: 16,', 'fontSize: 17,', 1)
          text = text[:grid_start] + grid + text[grid_end:]
          preview_start = text.index('class _BlockPreview extends StatelessWidget')
          preview_end = text.index('// ---- Done checkbox', preview_start)
          preview = text[preview_start:preview_end]
          preview = preview.replace('fontSize: 12,', 'fontSize: 13,')
          preview = preview.replace('fontSize: 10,', 'fontSize: 11,')
          preview = preview.replace('block.level == 1 ? 13 : 12', 'block.level == 1 ? 14 : 13')
          text = text[:preview_start] + preview + text[preview_end:]
          large_start = text.index('class _LargeDoneCheck extends StatelessWidget')
          large_end = text.index('class _CategoryTile extends StatelessWidget', large_start)
          large = '''class _LargeDoneCheck extends StatelessWidget {
            const _LargeDoneCheck({
              required this.isDone,
              required this.onToggle,
            });

            final bool isDone;
            final VoidCallback onToggle;

            @override
            Widget build(BuildContext context) {
              final scheme = Theme.of(context).colorScheme;
              return Semantics(
                button: true,
                checked: isDone,
                child: SizedBox.square(
                  dimension: 44,
                  child: Material(
                    color: Colors.transparent,
                    child: InkWell(
                      onTap: onToggle,
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                      child: Center(
                        child: AnimatedContainer(
                          duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 120),
                          width: 26,
                          height: 26,
                          decoration: BoxDecoration(
                            color: isDone ? scheme.primary : Colors.transparent,
                            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
                            border: Border.all(
                              color: isDone
                                  ? scheme.primary
                                  : scheme.outline.withValues(alpha: 0.55),
                              width: 1.5,
                            ),
                          ),
                          child: isDone
                              ? Icon(
                                  Icons.check_rounded,
                                  size: 18,
                                  color: scheme.onPrimary,
                                )
                              : null,
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              );
            }
          }

          '''
          text = text[:large_start] + large + text[large_end:]
          save(path, text)

          # 3) Quick add: larger field, exactly same height, circular + only.
          path = 'lib/features/notes/widgets/notes_library_production_shell.dart'
          text = load(path)
          text = text.replace("    final compactMobile = MediaQuery.sizeOf(context).shortestSide < 600;\n", '')
          text = text.replace('            height: 40,', '            height: 48,', 1)
          text = text.replace('              style: TextStyle(fontSize: 14, color: scheme.onSurface),',
                              '              style: TextStyle(fontSize: 15, color: scheme.onSurface),', 1)
          text = text.replace('                  fontSize: 14,', '                  fontSize: 15,', 1)
          old_button = '''        SizedBox(
          width: compactMobile ? 40 : null,
          height: 40,
          child: Tooltip(
            message: t(locale, 'add'),
            child: Material(
              color: scheme.primary,
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(999),
              child: InkWell(
                onTap: onSubmit,
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(999),
                child: compactMobile
                    ? Center(
                        child: Icon(
                          Icons.add_rounded,
                          size: 20,
                          color: scheme.onPrimary,
                        ),
                      )
                    : Padding(
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 14),
                        child: Row(
                          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                          mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
                          children: [
                            Icon(
                              Icons.add_rounded,
                              size: 18,
                              color: scheme.onPrimary,
                            ),
                            const SizedBox(width: 4),
                            Text(
                              t(locale, 'add'),
                              style: TextStyle(
                                fontSize: 13,
                                fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                                color: scheme.onPrimary,
                              ),
                            ),
                          ],
                        ),
                      ),
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ),'''
          new_button = '''        SizedBox.square(
          dimension: 48,
          child: Tooltip(
            message: t(locale, 'add'),
            child: Material(
              color: scheme.primary,
              shape: const CircleBorder(),
              child: InkWell(
                onTap: onSubmit,
                customBorder: const CircleBorder(),
                child: Center(
                  child: Icon(
                    Icons.add_rounded,
                    size: 24,
                    color: scheme.onPrimary,
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ),'''
          if old_button not in text:
              raise SystemExit('quick-add button block not found')
          text = text.replace(old_button, new_button, 1)
          save(path, text)

          # 4) Keep Notes checkbox-mode cards fixed in place when done toggles.
          path = 'lib/features/lists/lists_view.dart'
          rep(path,
              "  void _notesLibrarySort(List<PlanningTask> list) {\n    final db = DatabaseService.instance;\n",
              "  void _notesLibrarySort(List<PlanningTask> list) {\n    if (_notesCheckboxesOn) return;\n    final db = DatabaseService.instance;\n")
          rep(path,

              "            final forGrouping = _notesCheckboxesOn\n                ? List<PlanningTask>.from(flat)\n                : listBeh == 'archive'\n                ? () {")
          rep(path,
              "            final archiveSlice = listBeh == 'archive'\n                ? _listsArchiveDoneSlice(flat)\n                : const <PlanningTask>[];",
              "            final archiveSlice = _notesCheckboxesOn\n                ? const <PlanningTask>[]\n                : listBeh == 'archive'\n                ? _listsArchiveDoneSlice(flat)\n                : const <PlanningTask>[];")

          # 5) Shared category tree gains optional checkbox selection without
          # changing existing Edit-sheet single-select behavior.
          path = 'lib/shared/categories/tree/category_tree_body.dart'
          rep(path,
              "    required this.selectedCategoryId,\n    this.expandSelectionPath = false,",
              "    required this.selectedCategoryId,\n    this.checkedCategoryIds,\n    this.onCheckedChanged,\n    this.expandSelectionPath = false,")
          rep(path,
              "  final int? selectedCategoryId;\n\n  /// When false,",
              "  final int? selectedCategoryId;\n  final Set<int>? checkedCategoryIds;\n  final void Function(int id, bool checked)? onCheckedChanged;\n\n  /// When false,")
          rep(path,
              "            selectedCategoryId: widget.selectedCategoryId,\n            expandedIds: _expandedIds,",
              "            selectedCategoryId: widget.selectedCategoryId,\n            checkedCategoryIds: widget.checkedCategoryIds,\n            onCheckedChanged: widget.onCheckedChanged,\n            expandedIds: _expandedIds,")
          rep(path,
              "    required this.selectedCategoryId,\n    required this.expandedIds,",
              "    required this.selectedCategoryId,\n    this.checkedCategoryIds,\n    this.onCheckedChanged,\n    required this.expandedIds,")
          rep(path,
              "  final int? selectedCategoryId;\n  final Set<int> expandedIds;",
              "  final int? selectedCategoryId;\n  final Set<int>? checkedCategoryIds;\n  final void Function(int id, bool checked)? onCheckedChanged;\n  final Set<int> expandedIds;")
          rep(path,
              "            else\n              const SizedBox(width: 12),\n            Expanded(",
              "            else\n              const SizedBox(width: 12),\n            if (checkedCategoryIds != null)\n              SizedBox(\n                width: 40,\n                height: 40,\n                child: Checkbox(\n                  value: checkedCategoryIds!.contains(rule.id),\n                  onChanged: onCheckedChanged == null\n                      ? null\n                      : (value) => onCheckedChanged!(rule.id, value ?? false),\n                ),\n              ),\n            Expanded(")
          rep(path,
              "                    selectedCategoryId: selectedCategoryId,\n                    expandedIds: expandedIds,",
              "                    selectedCategoryId: selectedCategoryId,\n                    checkedCategoryIds: checkedCategoryIds,\n                    onCheckedChanged: onCheckedChanged,\n                    expandedIds: expandedIds,")

          # 6) Add checkbox/multi-select mode to the exact shared Edit-sheet picker.
          path = 'lib/shared/categories/picker/category_tree_picker.dart'
          text = load(path)
          marker = "/// Picker sheet: returns chosen category id, or null if dismissed unchanged.\n"
          if marker not in text:
              raise SystemExit('category picker insertion marker not found')
          multi = r'''Future<Set<int>?> showCategoryTreeMultiPicker(
            BuildContext context, {
            Set<int> initialCategoryIds = const <int>{},
          }) {
            return showModalBottomSheet<Set<int>>(
              context: context,
              isScrollControlled: true,
              showDragHandle: true,
              useSafeArea: true,
              builder: (ctx) {
                final sheetHeight =
                    (MediaQuery.sizeOf(ctx).height * 0.82).clamp(320.0, 720.0);
                return SizedBox(
                  height: sheetHeight,
                  child: _CategoryTreeMultiPickerSheet(
                    initialCategoryIds: initialCategoryIds,
                  ),
                );
              },
            );
          }

          class _CategoryTreeMultiPickerSheet extends StatefulWidget {
            const _CategoryTreeMultiPickerSheet({required this.initialCategoryIds});

            final Set<int> initialCategoryIds;

            @override
            State<_CategoryTreeMultiPickerSheet> createState() =>
                _CategoryTreeMultiPickerSheetState();
          }

          class _CategoryTreeMultiPickerSheetState
              extends State<_CategoryTreeMultiPickerSheet> {
            late final TextEditingController _searchController;
            late Set<int> _selectedIds;
            StreamSubscription<List<CategoryRule>>? _catSub;
            String _query = '';

            @override
            void initState() {
              super.initState();
              _selectedIds = Set<int>.from(widget.initialCategoryIds);
              _searchController = TextEditingController()
                ..addListener(() => setState(() => _query = _searchController.text));
              _catSub = CategoryTreeSource.watchCategories().listen((_) {
                if (mounted) setState(() {});
              });
            }

            @override
            void dispose() {
              _catSub?.cancel();
              _searchController.dispose();
              super.dispose();
            }

            List<CategoryRule> get _visibleRoots => filterCategoryRootsForPickerSearch(
                  CategoryTreeSource.childrenOf(null),
                  _query,
                  _labelForRule,
                );

            bool get _canCreate => categoryCreateFromPickerAllowed();

            Future<void> _createCategory({
              String? initialName,
              required CategoryPickerCreateTarget target,
            }) async {
              final id = await showCreateCategoryFromPickerDialog(
                context,
                initialName: initialName,
                target: target,
              );
              if (!mounted || id == null) return;
              setState(() => _selectedIds.add(id));
            }

            void _toggle(int id, [bool? checked]) {
              setState(() {
                final next = checked ?? !_selectedIds.contains(id);
                if (next) {
                  _selectedIds.add(id);
                } else {
                  _selectedIds.remove(id);
                }
              });
            }

            @override
            Widget build(BuildContext context) {
              final loc = currentLocale.value;
              final roots = _visibleRoots;
              final trimmedQuery = _query.trim();
              final showNamedCreate = trimmedQuery.isNotEmpty && roots.isEmpty;
              final offlineHint = _canCreate
                  ? null
                  : t(loc, 'category_create_requires_connection');
              return Padding(
                padding: EdgeInsets.only(
                  bottom: MediaQuery.viewInsetsOf(context).bottom,
                ),
                child: Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                  children: [
                    Padding(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 4, 16, 4),
                      child: Text(
                        t(loc, 'category_label'),
                        style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleMedium,
                      ),
                    ),
                    Padding(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 0, 16, 4),
                      child: TextField(
                        controller: _searchController,
                        decoration: InputDecoration(
                          isDense: true,
                          prefixIcon: const Icon(Icons.search_rounded),
                          hintText: t(loc, 'category_label'),
                        ),
                        textCapitalization: TextCapitalization.sentences,
                      ),
                    ),
                    categoryPickerCreateListTile(
                      key: categoryPickerTopAddKey,
                      label: t(loc, 'category_picker_add_root'),
                      subtitle: offlineHint,
                      onTap: _canCreate
                          ? () => unawaited(
                                _createCategory(
                                  target: const CategoryPickerCreateTarget.root(),
                                ),
                              )
                          : null,
                    ),
                    const Divider(height: 1),
                    Expanded(
                      child: ListView(
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(8, 0, 8, 0),
                        children: [
                          if (showNamedCreate)
                            categoryPickerCreateListTile(
                              key: const ValueKey<String>(
                                'category_multi_picker_named_create',
                              ),
                              label: t(loc, 'category_picker_create_named')
                                  .replaceFirst('%s', trimmedQuery),
                              subtitle: offlineHint,
                              onTap: _canCreate
                                  ? () => unawaited(
                                        _createCategory(
                                          initialName: trimmedQuery,
                                          target: const CategoryPickerCreateTarget.root(),
                                        ),
                                      )
                                  : null,
                            ),
                          if (roots.isEmpty && !showNamedCreate)
                            Padding(
                              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 16),
                              child: Text(
                                t(loc, 'category_picker_empty_hint'),
                                textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                              ),
                            )
                          else
                            CategoryTreeBody(
                              roots: roots,
                              selectedCategoryId: null,
                              checkedCategoryIds: _selectedIds,
                              onCheckedChanged: _toggle,
                              expandSelectionPath: false,
                              expandAll: false,
                              onSelect: (id) => _toggle(id),
                              showEditChrome: false,
                              showPickerCreateChrome: true,
                              onPickerAddChild: _canCreate
                                  ? (parent) => unawaited(
                                        _createCategory(
                                          target: CategoryPickerCreateTarget.child(
                                            parentLocalId: parent.id,
                                            parentDisplayName: _labelForRule(parent),
                                          ),
                                        ),
                                      )
                                  : null,
                            ),
                        ],
                      ),
                    ),
                    const Divider(height: 1),
                    Padding(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 10, 16, 12),
                      child: Row(
                        children: [
                          TextButton(
                            onPressed: () => Navigator.of(context).pop(),
                            child: Text(
                              MaterialLocalizations.of(context).cancelButtonLabel,
                            ),
                          ),
                          const Spacer(),
                          FilledButton(
                            onPressed: () => Navigator.of(context).pop(
                              Set<int>.unmodifiable(_selectedIds),
                            ),
                            child: Text(MaterialLocalizations.of(context).okButtonLabel),
                          ),
                        ],
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              );
            }
          }

          '''
          text = text.replace(marker, multi + marker, 1)
          save(path, text)

          # Notes category + button now uses the shared picker instead of its
          # separate custom tree implementation. Keep old code temporarily

          # 7) Structural Ctrl/Cmd+C + media continuation paragraph.
          path = 'lib/features/notes/notes_editor_document_controller.dart'
          rep(path,
              "  /// Paste a system clipboard string. Normal text keeps the existing editor\n",
              '''  NoteBlock? structuralSliceForSelection(
            String id,
            TextSelection selection,
          ) {
            final block = blockById(id);
            if (block == null || !isEditableText(block.type) ||
                !selection.isValid || selection.isCollapsed) {
              return null;
            }
            final start = selection.start.clamp(0, block.effectiveText.length).toInt();
            final end = selection.end.clamp(0, block.effectiveText.length).toInt();
            if (start >= end) return null;
            return block.copyWith(
              text: block.effectiveText.substring(start, end),
              runs: _sliceRuns(block.effectiveRuns, start, end),
            );
          }

          /// Paste a system clipboard string. Normal text keeps the existing editor
''')

          path = 'lib/features/notes/note_editor_page.dart'
          rep(path,
              "    if (event.logicalKey == LogicalKeyboardKey.keyV &&\n        (keyboard.isControlPressed || keyboard.isMetaPressed)) {",
              '''    if (event.logicalKey == LogicalKeyboardKey.keyC &&
              (keyboard.isControlPressed || keyboard.isMetaPressed) &&
              selection.isValid &&
              !selection.isCollapsed) {
            final slice = _editor.structuralSliceForSelection(block.id, selection);
            if (slice != null) {
              final start = selection.start.clamp(0, controller.text.length).toInt();
              final end = selection.end.clamp(0, controller.text.length).toInt();
              final plain = controller.text.substring(start, end);
              _NotesStructuredClipboard.plainText = plain;
              _NotesStructuredClipboard.blocks = <NoteBlock>[slice];
              unawaited(Clipboard.setData(ClipboardData(text: plain)));

          old_drawing = '''        final mutation = editBlockId == null
            ? _editor.insertAfter(
                _editor.activeBlockId,
                NoteBlockType.drawing,

          new_drawing = '''        if (editBlockId == null) {
          final drawingMutation = _editor.insertAfter(
            _editor.activeBlockId,
            NoteBlockType.drawing,
            drawingData: dataUrl,
          );
          final drawingId = _editor.activeBlockId;

          old_checkbox = '''      child: InkWell(

          save(path, text)

          path = 'lib/features/notes/widgets/note_editor_block_widgets.dart'
          text = load(path)
          # Make non-editing list/checklist rows match editing geometry exactly.
          text = text.replace('''          padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(
            kNotesContentInset,
            10,
            kNotesContentInset,

          ),''', '''          padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(

          text = text.replace('''                width: kNotesLeadingSize,
                height: 24,''', '''                width: kNotesLeadingSize,
                height: 32,''', 2)
          old_static = '''                  child: InkWell(
                    onTap: onCheckedChanged == null
                        ? null
                        : () => onCheckedChanged!(!block.checked),
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(6),
                    child: Container(

                              Icons.check_rounded,
                              size: 14,
                              color: NotesFigmaTokens.selectedIcon(context),
                            )
                          : null,
                    ),
                  ),'''
          new_static = '''                  child: InkWell(
                    onTap: onCheckedChanged == null
                        ? null
                        : () => onCheckedChanged!(!block.checked),
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
                    child: SizedBox.square(
                      dimension: 32,
                      child: Center(
                        child: Container(
                          width: 20,
                          height: 20,
                          decoration: BoxDecoration(
                            color: block.checked
                                ? NotesFigmaTokens.selectedSurface(context)
                                : Colors.transparent,
                            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(6),
                            border: block.checked
                                ? null
                                : Border.all(
                                    color: NotesFigmaTokens.textPrimary(
                                      context,
                                    ).withValues(alpha: 0.15),
                                  ),
                          ),
                          child: block.checked
                              ? Icon(
                                  Icons.check_rounded,
                                  size: 14,
                                  color: NotesFigmaTokens.selectedIcon(context),
                                )
                              : null,
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),'''
          if old_static not in text:
              raise SystemExit('selectable checklist checkbox block missing')
          text = text.replace(old_static, new_static, 1)
          save(path, text)

          print('Changed files:')
          import subprocess
          subprocess.run(['git', 'diff', '--stat'], check=True)
          PY
          git diff --check

      - name: Commit focused source changes to main
        run: |
          git config user.name 'nkuchenov-hash'
          git config user.email 'nkuchenov-hash@users.noreply.github.com'
          git add lib/features/notes lib/features/lists/lists_view.dart lib/features/lists/lists_filters.dart lib/shared/categories
          git commit -m 'Fix Notes category picker cards clipboard and editor UX'
          git push origin HEAD:main
          echo "SOURCE_SHA=$(git rev-parse HEAD)" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

      - name: Set up Flutter 3.41.6
        uses: subosito/flutter-action@v2
        with:
          flutter-version: '3.41.6'
          channel: stable

      - name: Create env.dart
        run: |
          mkdir -p lib/core/env
          printf '%s\n' 'abstract final class Env {' '  static const String placeholder = '\'''\'';' '}' > lib/core/env/env.dart

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: flutter pub get

      - name: Verify focused patch
        run: |
          flutter analyze --no-fatal-infos --no-fatal-warnings
          flutter build web --release --base-href="/Counter/" --no-tree-shake-icons --no-wasm-dry-run --pwa-strategy=none \
            --dart-define=GIT_COMMIT="$(git rev-parse --short HEAD)" \
            --dart-define=BUILD_TIME="$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"
          printf '%s\n' "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" > build/web/.lifeos-source-sha

      - name: Preserve companion content and deploy trigger
        run: |
          if [ -d pages/igropoisk ]; then
            rm -rf build/web/igropoisk
            cp -R pages/igropoisk build/web/igropoisk
          fi
          mkdir -p build/web/.github/workflows
          cp pages/.github/workflows/deploy.yml build/web/.github/workflows/deploy.yml

      - name: Deploy verified build to gh-pages
        uses: JamesIves/github-pages-deploy-action@v4
        with:
          folder: build/web
          branch: gh-pages
          commit-message: 'Deploy Notes UX batch from ${{ env.SOURCE_SHA }}'
